{{Top|leg}}
'''Atmosphere canisters''' were disposable vessels that could hold up to an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] of breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] when attached to a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]]. Canisters weighed a [[Kilogram/Legends|kilogram]] and cost twenty-five [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>
